title: zazz module component diagram
description: The zazz subcommands behind one router. add and test share the build-and-test pipeline (compile.rs, sdk.rs) and zazz-worker; add publishes into the registry after checking the signature and taking a trust verdict. call, run and installed shims run a registered script in a warm worker from the pool, with the network and paths the verdict grants. Builds and test runs go through the OS sandbox; rustc and zazz-worker are found at fixed places.

components.name: zazz module
components.responsibility: Runs one `zazz` command line for an agent or a person.

components.name: Router and state (mod.rs)
components.responsibility: Routes the subcommand (with `exec-name` for shims), answers help, turns JSON results into replies; Zazz holds the registry root, worker, shim, invoker, trust and keys locations and the pool; output_path and write_new confine and write output files.

components.name: new, doctor and pack (setup.rs, pack.rs)
components.responsibility: A script template with a manifest, src/main.rs and tests/basic.rs; a check of rustc, the wasm32-wasip1 target, zazz-worker, the sandbox, the registry and the shim directory; a deterministic .zazz from a directory with its id.

components.name: add (add.rs)
components.responsibility: Reads the file once (no symlinks, regular, within the size limit), ids it by BLAKE3, answers `cached` when registered, else under the id's lock checks the signature, takes a verdict, builds and tests, builds natively when trusted for it, publishes the modules and metadata, and fetches the OpenAPI document when declared.

components.name: test (testcmd.rs)
components.responsibility: Packs a directory (or reads a .zazz) and runs the build-and-test pipeline without registering anything; --update rewrites a directory's snapshots.

components.name: Build pipeline (pipeline.rs, compile.rs, sdk.rs)
components.responsibility: Extracts the archive into scratch space, compiles Rust scripts and their tests to wasm32-wasip1 against the embedded SDK (built once per toolchain into an rlib) or takes a prebuilt module, condenses rustc's diagnostics, AOT-compiles with `zazz-worker compile` and runs the tests with `zazz-worker test` in the sandbox; refuses native-bin.

components.name: Native builds (native.rs)
components.responsibility: For scripts whose signer is trusted for native code: a host build and its tests (libtest output parsed) in the sandbox, and the program and sandbox policy a native worker runs with.

components.name: Registry (registry.rs)
components.responsibility: The store under $ZAZZ_STORE or ~/.zazzle/v1/zazz (0700): wasm, bin, meta, names, locks, tmp and sdk; atomic writes, per-id locks, id, prefix and name resolution, scratch directories and removal.

components.name: call (call.rs)
components.responsibility: Parses `ID [JSON|-]` or `ID OP [--params] [--body]`, refreshes a stale verdict in the background, builds the worker spec (preopens from the manifest narrowed by the grants, network, limits; native or WASM), sends the call with the caller's streams or capture pipes, relays progress, cancels when the caller hangs up and enforces a watchdog.

components.name: Worker pool (pool.rs)
components.responsibility: Spawns a worker with the control socket on fd 3 and the module on fd 4 and waits for ready; keeps at most 2 idle per key and 32 in all, retires workers after 1000 calls, an unhealthy call or 60 s idle (a reaper every 5 s).

components.name: Human commands (human.rs, install.rs)
components.responsibility: `zazz run` and shims: argv parsed with the manifest's cli spec (or passed as argv), output rendered as text or a table on a terminal, `--json` for raw JSON, exit statuses; install (adding a file first if needed), uninstall and list of names and ~/.zazzle/bin shims linked to the invoker.

components.name: ls, describe and rm (manage.rs)
components.responsibility: Lists registered scripts newest first, describes one (runtime, messages, sandbox, operations, tests, signer) and removes one with its installed names.

components.name: Signing (signing.rs, crypto.rs)
components.responsibility: keygen (a P-256 key, 0600, and a self-signed authority certificate with the zazz signing EKU and grants), sign (a copy of the archive with zazz.sig), trust ls|add|rm, and signature and certificate-chain checks.

components.name: Trust (trust.rs)
components.responsibility: The root-owned global policy, the root-owned anchors in /etc/zazzle/trust.d, the Keychain on macOS, verdicts with grants valid for trust_ttl, grant intersection and what a verdict allows after the policy.

components.name: OS sandbox (sandbox.rs)
components.responsibility: Policy (read, write, exec, network) turned into a sandbox-exec profile with -D parameters on macOS, or Landlock rules and a seccomp socket filter applied in the child on Linux; available() says whether scripts may run.

components.name: Tools and subprocesses (tools.rs, proc.rs)
components.responsibility: Finds rustc at fixed places before PATH (which launchd leaves nearly empty) and zazz-worker beside zazzled or at $ZAZZ_WORKER; builds the sandboxed rustc command with a minimal environment and, on macOS, the linker found by xcrun; runs a subprocess with an argument list, input, captured output and a hard timeout.

components.name: MCP tools (mcptools.rs)
components.responsibility: zazz_new, zazz_test, zazz_pack, zazz_add, zazz_call, zazz_describe and zazz_ls, each mapped to a zazz command line.

components.name: zazzled library
components.responsibility: The command layer (Ctx, Output, Caller), the socket server and the MCP front end that route `zazz` commands here.

components.name: zazz-worker
components.responsibility: The wasmtime host: compile, test and serve.

components.name: zazz-format
components.responsibility: The .zazz archive, manifest, packing, signature envelope and script ids.

components.name: zazz-sdk (lib zazz)
components.responsibility: Frames, descriptor passing, JSON, the human CLI parser and rendering; its sources are also embedded and compiled into scripts.

components.name: Rust toolchain
components.responsibility: rustc with the wasm32-wasip1 target (and the host target and system linker for native builds), installed by the user.

components.name: OS sandbox
components.responsibility: /usr/bin/sandbox-exec on macOS; the kernel's Landlock and seccomp on Linux.

components.name: macOS Keychain
components.responsibility: Certificate trust evaluation and trust settings for authorities (security-framework), on macOS only.
